operations.before: ### R3.3 — Sensitive attributes and fairness definitions
operations.after:
**Current A90 extension: the complete non-IID S-DFA scene.** The [accepted A90 table](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_A_nine_scenes90_20261011/TABLES.md) and [root verification](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_A_nine_scenes90_20261011/ROOT_VERIFICATION.json) preserve all eight A80 scenes and add non-IID S-DFA, giving nine complete scenes and 90 Full/minus_A pairs (180 records). Each scene uses the same ten model seeds for both variants and all metrics, with raw/native/shared predictions from each model's fixed round-70 checkpoint on the same 19,867 validation images. The five available non-IID Sp-DFA pairs are excluded from all displayed scene statistics; they do not complete the remaining A scene.

**Added non-IID S-DFA evidence.** The ten-seed paired differences, minus_A−Full, are -0.036 ± 0.727 / -0.00434 ± 0.01082 / -0.00145 ± 0.02006 for native/shared calibration and +0.014 ± 0.828 / -0.01156 ± 0.02246 / -0.00835 ± 0.01716 for raw, in ΔACC / ΔAEOD / ΔASPD order. These are means ± sample SD (ddof=1); ΔACC is in percentage points and AEOD/ASPD differences are absolute gaps. Under native/shared prediction, deleting A lowers mean accuracy while lowering both disparity means; under raw prediction it raises mean accuracy and lowers both gaps. The raw ten-seed result is therefore a counterexample to a universal benefit from retaining A across all three measured objectives. It is a statement about panel means, not every seed, statistical significance or component necessity.

**Fixed sensitivity panels and interpretation.** The [saved values](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_A_nine_scenes90_20261011/tables.json) report all 10/9/6-seed panels together. Native/shared AEOD is lower after deletion in the ten- and nine-seed panels but higher in the six-seed panel; raw ACC is higher in the ten- and nine-seed panels but lower in the six-seed panel. Native/shared ACC remains lower and ASPD lower in all three panels, while both raw disparity means remain lower. Thus the descriptive direction depends on the prediction rule and predefined seed subset. Deleting A removes its score contribution while geometric hard filtering and prediction calibration remain enabled, so this comparison does not isolate an aggregation mechanism or prove that A is indispensable. Native/shared equality is a property of the saved records, not independent confirmation. AEOD is the absolute TPR gap, not full equalized odds.

**Current A90 comparability and remaining scope.** The adopted replay-device counts are Full (cpu: 5, cuda:0: 85); minus_A (cpu: 90); the recorded training-build counts are Full (2.11.0+cu128: 88, 2.11.0+cu130: 2); minus_A (2.11.0+cu128: 90). The A80 counts above describe its historical subset. Native/shared metrics and saved group counts coincide within all 180 records. The [five-IID seed-first aggregate](E:/OneDrive/文档/GuardFed/docs/server_deployment_20260923/training_20260923/celeba_mechanism_v1/three_view_A_nine_scenes90_20261011/IID_SEED_FIRST.json) remains byte-identical: IID scenes are averaged within each seed before the across-seed summary; the four non-IID scenes are reported separately, without an imbalanced nine-scene aggregate. The nine-seed panel excludes configuration-selection seed 91001, and the six-seed panel uses 91005–91010, identically for Full and minus_A. Mixed devices/builds/driver histories, root-only calibration, exposed validation and previously inspected official-test results remain disclosed; no runtime/trajectory equivalence or untouched confirmation is claimed. Non-IID Sp-DFA and the other five image-control variants remain incomplete; U100 and C100 are unchanged. This is A90, not A100, a complete 17-method benchmark or an all-component study. The final primary endpoint, frozen final evaluation and submitted-manuscript integration remain pending. These are author-review insertion candidates, not applied manuscript changes or final-test results.
